plugin_update.cannot_repair: The Claude Code plugin needs a repair, but it cannot be done now; no hooks are registered in settings.json (they would be duplicates). {warning}
plugin_update.marketplace_plan: refreshes the local marketplace "{name}" from the folder of the installed package
plugin_update.migration: Claude Code moves from the settings delivery to the plugin: the hooks leave settings.json (a copy is kept) and the read-block switch is preserved.
plugin_update.restart_sessions: Restart any open Claude Code sessions: the new plugin is only loaded when a session starts.
plugin_update.retire_done: Removed {n} hook(s) from settings.json and the folder {path}: the plugin runs them.
plugin_update.retire_plan: removes from settings.json the local-delegate hooks that duplicate those of the plugin {plugin}, and the folder {path}
plugin_update.update_plan: updates the plugin {plugin} to the package version ({version})
